{{Quote|Well, well. What have we here?''"<br />"''I think, my brother, this little Jedi plans to disrupt our modest operation.''"<br />"''That certainly won't do, will it, Vinoc?''"<br />"''I'm afraid you're right, Karoc. Not at all!|Vinoc and Karoc|<ref name="NDA" />}}
'''Vinoc''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was one of [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolytes]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was also the brother of [[Karoc]] and wielded a red-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. They were sent by Count Dooku to protect the [[C-B3 cortosis battle droid/Legends|cortosis droid]] factories on [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]]. He and his brother were confronted by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and a fierce duel was fought. They were ultimately defeated by the young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].

==Powers and abilities==
Vinoc fought in sync with his brother Karoc, circling Skywalker on Metalorn to box him in. His lightsaber style resembled a composite of [[Form III/Legends|Soresu]] and [[Form II/Legends|Makashi]].<ref name="NDA" />
